scenario: The ego vehicle travels straight through an intersection while an adversarial car runs a red light from the right, causing a collision.

ego.behavior: The car travels straight forward through the intersection.

adversarials.behavior: The car approaches from the right side of the intersection, fails to stop, and enters the intersection at high speed.

spatial_relation: The ego vehicle is positioned on a straight road approaching a signalized intersection from the south, while the adversarial car is positioned on the crossroad approaching from the east.
requirements_and_restrictions: The ego vehicle faces a green light while the adversarial vehicle faces a red light; the scenario terminates upon collision between the two vehicles.

road_side_structures.position: Positioned near the intersection on the right side of the ego vehicle's approach.
Located on the sidewalk near the corner of the intersection to the right of the ego vehicle.

reasoning_chain: 1. Actors: Ego is the centered car from top-down view; the red car entering from right is adversarial. 2. Chronology: initially ego approaches intersection, adversarial is distant on crossroad; midpoint adversarial enters intersection without stopping; ending collision occurs. 3. Evidence: adversarial's position shifts rapidly from right edge to intersection center while ego maintains straight trajectory.
